hypothesis: EMA 20/60 and neighboring speeds can improve development risk-adjusted trend-following performance across US/KR; selected candidate must then satisfy preregistered evaluation criteria against baseline and equal-weight buy-hold
selection_reason: First backlog item; prior seed SMA50/200 OOS underperformed buy-hold, motivating faster EMA comparison without using new OOS to tune

This set initial Yahoo preparation failed before strategy execution; Toss24-symbol snapshot now revalidated
data_version_boundary: Current-vintage Toss adjusted-price returns; not Yahoo dividend-reinvested total returns. Original source snapshots retained. Fixed-survivor universe; calendar completeness not certified.
coverage: US/KR12 each;2015-01-02 to2026-11-09 except207940 begins2016-11-10; no imputation or omission

splits.evaluation: engine OOS date>=2022-12-31; no actual boundary trading day because Saturday
splits.boundary_verification: src/backtest.rs split at pinned engine; costs US0.0005/KR0.0025 one-way turnover; next-bar position; available-asset equal weighting

prior_oos_exposure: Seed SMA historical OOS previously read. Same fixed split reused, not untouched holdout. New run IS and OOS are jointly computed/stored; ranking reads only IS. No claim of technical OOS isolation.

selection.objective: maximize arithmetic mean of US and KR IS sharpe as stored by engine (4 decimals)
selection.tie_break: then maximize mean IS cagr, then maximize mean IS mdd (less negative), then baseline first, then lexicographic run_id; exact Decimal comparisons of stored values

evaluation.benchmark: engine available-asset equal-weight buy-and-hold using same provider adjusted-price closes
evaluation.accept_criteria: selected OOS sharpe>0 in BOTH markets AND mean OOS excess_cagr>=0 AND mean selected OOS mdd>=mean baseline OOS mdd
evaluation.reject_criteria: if not accept: selected OOS excess_cagr<0 in BOTH markets AND mean selected OOS sharpe<=mean baseline OOS sharpe
evaluation.defer_criteria: all other successful research outcomes; never operational failure
evaluation.precedence: accept then reject then defer; no parameter changes after observation

stop_conditions: Run all four preregistered candidates; no performance early stop. Data/code drift, missing required metrics/universe, timeout/budget failure=>blocked/null. Failed strategy repair gets new immutable ID and consumes budget. Need baseline+>=2 distinct variants successful and all scheduled trials or protocol remains blocked.
revision_policy: No post-observation changes; preserve failed data evidence and only add report addendum.
publication_policy: raw/CSV/metrics/curves/selection numeric evidence private outside Git; public descriptors and SHA-256 only. No Toss performance in dashboard.
